Title: Vinext 1.0 - A New Alternative to Next.js
Description:
This Next.js alternative just officially hit 1.0.

Vinext 1.0 gives Next.js apps a new path to Vite and Cloudflare Workers. Let's break down what Vinext is, which Next.js features it supports, how it compares with OpenNext, and where its cache warming approach fits into incremental static regeneration.

OpenNext - https://opennext.js.org/
